register_model_type: register a new ModelTypeConfig with config_loader, model_factory, and model_loader into the registry
get_model_config: get the ModelTypeConfig for a registered model type name from the registry
get_model_loader: get the model_loader callable for a given model type from the registry
create_model_type_config: create a ModelTypeConfig dataclass with model_type, config_loader, model_factory, and model_loader fields
use_global_registry: use the lcm_model_type_registry singleton to register and look up model types
